Subject: Re: Nov invoice: aggregation bucket mismatch & VAT status — preliminary analysis

Hi all,

Thanks Marcus — I pulled the account history and ran a quick reconciliation. Attaching the CSV with row-level deltas (redwood_usage_window_analysis_20261201.csv) and a short sample of session events (session_samples_20261129.log). Key findings so far: 

• Summary delta: billed tokens (platform) = 3,812,240; client-supplied finalized tokens = 890,121; delta = 2,922,119 (~3.9x).
• Root-cause signal: on 2026-11-29 23:00 UTC we rolled a change to the streaming flush service (rollforward: streaming-session-finalize v2.3.1). That deploy changed the finalize ACK semantics; a subset of sessions generated both a partial-stream event (counted when seen) and a finalized-summary event within the same billing window. Our aggregation job should dedupe on session_id but we found ~0.7% of session_ids with duplicate events because the finalize message arrived after a short reingest that produced a duplicate event id. Those duplicates were not deduped and were aggregated as additive tokens.
• Affected window: primarily 2026-11-29 22:40 UTC through 2026-11-30 01:10 UTC (UTC-based billing windows).

Immediate proposal:
1) We will programmatically identify duplicated session_ids for SENT-8711, remove the duplicated partial events, and recompute the billed usage for Nov.
2) If the recomputed billed amount reduces the invoice, we'll issue a credit for the delta and produce a corrected invoice (net of VAT if you provide valid EU VAT exemption documentation).
3) We will backport a fix to the aggregation pipeline dedupe logic to prevent recurrence (JIRA BILL-4982).

Estimated impact & timing:
- Estimated provisional credit: $18,450 (gross) based on current rates; final number after full recompute expected within 48 hours.
- Corrected invoice and credit note to be issued by EOD +2 business days after we complete the recompute.

Attachments: redwood_usage_window_analysis_20261201.csv (row-level delta, 48KB); session_samples_20261129.log (snippets showing duplicate session ids)

Related links: JIRA BILL-4982, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-link (analysis folder)
